name: How much does adding one bedroom to a house in San Diego cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does adding one bedroom to a house in San Diego cost?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The price depends on more than bedroom square footage. San Diego-area published planning references place a single-room addition around $150,000–$250,000 or more, while a primary suite with a bathroom and additional plumbing may be substantially higher.

Those figures are not a quote for your property. Foundation, roof, utilities, windows, insulation, finishes, site access, and permit-related work can materially change the total.

Key factors:
- Ground-level versus second-story construction
- Bedroom size and closet design
- Bathroom, laundry, or plumbing additions
- Structural and site conditions

Ask Elite Remodeling & Design for a scope-based estimate that separates design, permits, construction, allowances, and possible unknowns. Comparing only a price per square foot can hide major differences in what each proposal includes.
acceptedAnswer.description: A San Diego bedroom addition may fall around $150,000–$250,000 or more as a planning reference, but the actual cost depends on foundation, roof, utilities, size, finishes, site access, and permitting. Request a detailed scope instead of relying only on square-foot pricing.
